CONTEXT CHANGES THE CONVERSATION

An isolated finding is only part of the story.

An exposed workload matters. The identity that can access it matters too. So does the control expected to protect it. SAFORA puts those perspectives within reach of the same team, so an investigation can start with a better question.

A WORKSPACE WITH ACCOUNTABILITY

Clear boundaries.
Traceable decisions.

A shared security picture needs clear responsibilities. SAFORA keeps workspace context, permissions and activity visible within the platform.

01 / WORKSPACES

Keep organizational context separate.

Tenant-scoped views and workspace memberships keep investigations within the active organization.

02 / PERMISSIONS

Make responsibilities explicit.

Admin, editor and viewer memberships distinguish who can investigate from who can change platform data.

03 / AUDIT HISTORY

Retain the context of a change.

Audited mutations and finding history provide a record of activity alongside the investigation.

GOOD QUESTIONS. CLEAR ANSWERS.

Let's make
the picture clearer.

Ask the SAFORA team
What is SAFORA?

SAFORA is a cybersecurity command center that brings exposure, identity, cloud security, control validation and organizational risk into a shared workspace. Teams can move from a posture summary into the findings and evidence behind it.

Who is the platform designed for?

Security operations, cloud and identity teams, and security leaders who need a consistent perspective on their environment. A walkthrough can focus on the workflows most relevant to your team.

Does this preview use live security data?

No. The interactive explorer uses illustrative demo data. The current product uses seeded integration data; discuss production data connections and remediation integrations with the team for your environment.

How can we see the platform in action?

Email support@safora.ai to request a guided demo. Tell us about your environment and priorities so we can focus the conversation.
